title: MVP: Concept Mapping

Acceptance
- DB initializes cleanly with all MVP tables and constraints
- FTS5-backed note search is wired to notes content

title: Performance targets + indexes/benchmarks

title: Deduplicate map views per MVP spec
description: MVP requires melvil map --book and --concept to be deduped by concept/book. Current implementation shows per-mention rows (similar to concept mentions). Adjust queries/output and add tests.

title: Handle invalid FTS query errors in notes search
description: notes search uses MATCH with raw user input in src/cli.py:notes_search. Malformed FTS5 queries raise sqlite3.OperationalError and currently bubble out as a traceback. Catch OperationalError and surface a ClickException with guidance or example syntax.
close_reason: Handled invalid FTS query errors in notes search.

title: Add CLI dependencies to pyproject
description: Tests failed running make test because click is missing from the project environment (ModuleNotFoundError). Add runtime deps for CLI (at least click; likely rich too) to pyproject.toml so uv run pytest installs them.

title: Review codebase for defects and risks
description: Perform a code review pass focusing on correctness, edge cases, and regression risk. Capture findings and follow-ups as linked beads.

title: Fix book concept listing ambiguity
description: In , book concept listings in  and  use  while selecting , , . SQLite returns arbitrary values when a concept is linked multiple times, so users see incorrect chapter/location/notes. Decide on intended behavior (aggregate all mentions or list every mention) and update queries/output accordingly.
close_reason: Listed all concept mentions per book and stabilized ordering

title: Fix wikilink concept creation on empty DB
description: resolve_or_create_concept_id only creates on 'No concept found' but resolve_concept_id raises 'No concepts found.' when table empty. This breaks melvil note with [[wikilink]] on new DB. Update behavior and add test coverage.

title: Manual TOC entries lack ordering; concept/map outputs sort lexicographically
description: toc.add inserts chapters with position=NULL, so toc show orders by id and concept/map queries order by ch.number (TEXT), leading to incorrect chapter ordering (e.g., 1,10,2). Set position on manual inserts (e.g., max+1) and use position (fallback to page_start) in ORDER BY for chapter-related queries in cli.map/show/mentions to keep ordering stable.

title: Add export format tests
description: Add unit tests for export_map_json/markdown/dot output ordering, escaping, and summary sections. Use fixture data to validate deterministic output.

title: Improve viz readability with labels or side panel
description: TUI viz renders unlabeled nodes; map is hard to interpret. Add labels or a side panel/legend with focused node details per MVP 'see the map' goal. Add tests or docs if needed.

title: Add tests for book concept listings with multiple mentions
description: Cover show and map book output when a concept is linked multiple times (different chapters/locations/notes) to ensure all mentions are shown and ordering is stable.

title: Add db/schema migration tests
description: Verify initialize creates tables, indexes, FTS triggers; foreign_keys pragma enabled; and notes_fts updates on insert/update/delete.

title: Show notes list in concept show output
description: MVP expects melvil concept show to display full context. Current output shows note count only. Add a notes list (ids/titles) and tests.

title: Fix book concept listing ambiguity
description: In src/cli.py, book concept listings in show and _map_book use GROUP BY c.id while selecting ch.number, bc.location, bc.notes. SQLite returns arbitrary values when a concept is linked multiple times, so users see incorrect chapter/location/notes. Decide on intended behavior (aggregate all mentions or list every mention) and update queries/output accordingly.
close_reason: Removed GROUP BY so all concept mentions show with chapter/location/notes.

title: Add Zotero integration tests
description: Test resolve_zotero_db_path (env vs explicit), find_item_by_title resolution/ambiguity, map_item_type, year parsing, and create_book_from_zotero using a minimal sqlite fixture DB.

title: Add CLI command tests
description: Cover add/show/list/depth/about/alias, concept, note, toc, export commands via Click CliRunner. Include success and error cases (invalid depth, ambiguous resolution, missing book/chapter, standard-note concept limit).

title: Export markdown drops location when chapter number exists
description: export_map_markdown only includes chapter number OR location for concept references; when both are present, location is discarded. Preserve both (e.g., 'Ch. 9, p.336') so exported maps don't lose provenance.

title: Quote command allows multiple concept links in standard notes
description: melvil quote creates notes with note_type='standard' but does not enforce the single-concept constraint (it skips the validation used by melvil note). This allows quotes to link to multiple concepts, violating SPEC_MVP 'standard notes can link to zero or one concept'. Add validation mirroring note() and return a friendly ClickException when too many concepts are supplied.

title: Support viz filtering by book
description: SPEC_MVP workflow examples include a viz --book command, but cli.viz only supports --focus. Add a --book option to show the book node + linked concepts (and optionally related concepts), or update docs to match current behavior.

title: Handle duplicate alias insert errors cleanly
description: cli.alias inserts into aliases without handling UNIQUE(alias) violations. Duplicate alias currently bubbles up as a raw sqlite exception. Catch sqlite3.IntegrityError and return a ClickException with a friendly message (e.g., alias already in use).

title: Add graph/viz unit tests
description: Cover build_graph focus filtering, node degrees, compute_layout determinism (seeded), scale_positions bounds, and draw_line behavior without Textual runtime.
